_comment: 1화 「안녕, 나는 쿵쿵이야!」 전체 컷 리스트. 확정 대본(docs/02_1화_대본.md)을 4~5초 단위 숏으로 분해한 것. {이름}은 전체 묘사, [이름]은 축약 묘사, characters에 없는 이름은 fragments로 치환된다. dialogue는 TTS 더빙과 자막용이며 이미지 프롬프트에는 들어가지 않는다. scenes.json(12컷 요약본)과 달리 이쪽이 정식 1화 분량이다.

sections.S1: Act 1 · S#1 숲속 공터 — 평화로운 일상
sections.S2: Act 1 · S#2 강물 위, 거대한 얼음덩어리
sections.S3: Act 1 · S#3 얼음 속에서 발견한 알
sections.S4: Act 1 · S#4 몸으로 얼음을 녹여주는 밤
sections.S5: Act 1 · S#5 새벽, 알이 깨어나는 순간
sections.S7: Act 2 · S#7 공터 — 친구들과 정식 인사

shots.image: a warm sunlit forest valley seen from above at dawn, mist drifting between trees, a winding river far below, storybook opening shot, wide aerial view
shots.motion: Slow aerial push forward over the misty forest valley, sunbeams breaking through, birds crossing the frame

shots.image: the series title card over a soft green forest background with wildflowers, gentle bokeh, warm morning light, empty center space for a title
shots.motion: Gentle parallax drift across the flower field, light particles floating, soft focus breathing

shots.image: a sunny forest clearing with lush grass and wildflowers, dappled afternoon light through tall trees, peaceful and inviting, no characters yet, cinematic wide shot
shots.motion: Camera pans slowly right across the empty clearing, grass swaying, leaves drifting down

shots.image: [소미] running through tall grass laughing over her shoulder, ears streaming behind her, warm afternoon backlight, dynamic medium shot
shots.motion: The rabbit bounds forward toward camera laughing, ears bouncing, grass parting around her

shots.image: [루카] chasing at full speed with a wide grin, goggles bouncing on his forehead, dust puffing from his paws, warm afternoon light, dynamic medium shot
shots.motion: The tiger cub sprints after her, paws kicking up dust, goggles bouncing, camera tracking sideways

shots.image: close-up of [초코] mid-leap with tongue out and ears flying, pure joy on his face, sunlit forest background blurred behind
shots.motion: The puppy leaps across frame in slow motion, ears and tongue flapping, sunlight flaring

shots.image: [루카], [소미], [초코] and [몽이] playing tag in a wide circle across the sunny clearing while [두리] watches from a mossy rock, joyful chaos, cinematic wide shot
shots.motion: Camera arcs around the group as they chase each other in a circle, everyone laughing, grass and petals stirred up

shots.image: [몽이] waddling as fast as he can with flippers spread, comically slow, his red beanie slipping over one eye, sunny clearing
shots.motion: The penguin waddles frantically, beanie sliding down over his eye, he pushes it back up and keeps going

shots.image: [두리] sitting on a mossy rock reading a small leaf-bound notebook, glasses glinting, unbothered by the chaos behind him, warm afternoon light
shots.motion: The koala turns a page calmly while blurred figures rush past behind him, he adjusts his glasses

shots.image: close-up of [소미] tagging [루카] on the shoulder with a delighted grin, both mid-motion, sun flare between them
shots.motion: The rabbit's paw taps the tiger's shoulder, both freeze in surprise then burst out laughing

shots.image: the five friends collapsing into the grass together in a tangled laughing pile, exhausted and happy, wildflowers around them, warm golden afternoon
shots.motion: The group tumbles into the grass together, chests heaving with laughter, petals drifting down over them

shots.image: close-up of five pairs of paws and flippers lying side by side in the grass, gently rising and falling, warm sunlight, tender detail shot
shots.motion: The paws rise and fall with breathing, a butterfly lands on one and flutters away

shots.image: the five friends lying in a circle in the grass looking up at a bright blue sky, contented smiles, viewed from directly above
shots.motion: Top-down view slowly rotating as the friends lie still, clouds drifting overhead reflected in their eyes

shots.image: the sunny forest clearing as the first shadow of a cloud slides across the grass, the light dimming slightly, subtle unease entering a peaceful scene
shots.motion: A cloud shadow sweeps across the clearing, the warm light draining to cool grey, the friends' ears perking up

shots.image: dark storm clouds boiling in over the forest treetops, the sky turning slate grey, wind bending the branches, ominous wide shot
shots.motion: Storm clouds roll in fast across the sky, treetops thrashing, the light dropping rapidly

shots.image: the five friends scrambling to their feet in the clearing as the first heavy raindrops hit, ears flattened, looking up at the darkening sky
shots.motion: The friends jump up, raindrops splashing on their fur, they shield their eyes and look up

shots.image: close-up of a single fat raindrop striking a broad green leaf and bursting apart, then more and more drops hammering down
shots.motion: One raindrop hits the leaf in slow motion and shatters, then the rain accelerates into a downpour

shots.image: heavy rain lashing the forest river, the water swollen and churning brown, branches tumbling in the current, dramatic storm lighting
shots.motion: The camera pushes low over the churning river, rain hammering the surface, debris sweeping past

shots.image: the five friends huddled together on the riverbank under a broad leaf, soaked and wide-eyed, watching the river rise
shots.motion: The friends huddle closer under the leaf, rain streaming off its edges, they flinch at a thunderclap

shots.image: a lightning flash illuminating the storm-dark river, and in that instant a massive pale ice block visible far upstream, dramatic silhouette
shots.motion: A lightning flash whites out the frame and reveals the distant ice block, then darkness returns

shots.image: close-up of [두리] with rain running down his glasses, mouth open in astonishment, one paw raised pointing off-screen
shots.motion: The koala's eyes go wide behind rain-streaked glasses, his paw slowly rises to point

shots.image: a massive ice block the size of a small house drifting down the swollen river toward camera, something faintly luminous deep inside it, heavy rain, dramatic storm lighting
shots.motion: The ice block drifts closer and closer, rain bouncing off its surface, a faint glow pulsing somewhere within

shots.image: the five friends running along the muddy riverbank keeping pace with the drifting ice block, slipping and splashing, urgent motion
shots.motion: The friends run along the bank through mud and puddles, camera tracking alongside them

shots.image: close-up of the ice block's surface streaming with rain, deep frost patterns inside, a soft light somewhere in its depths
shots.motion: Rain sheets down the ice surface, the interior light pulses once, slowly, like a breath

shots.image: [루카] skidding to a halt at the water's edge with one paw out to hold the others back, protective and alert, rain pouring
shots.motion: The tiger cub slides to a stop and throws out a paw to stop the others, all of them breathing hard

shots.image: the huge ice block swinging in the current and grinding to a halt against a cluster of boulders at the riverbank, spray flying, heavy rain
shots.motion: The ice block turns in the current and slams into the boulders with a shudder, spray bursting up, then it settles

shots.image: the five friends standing in the rain staring at the lodged ice block, small against its bulk, awed and hesitant
shots.motion: The friends stand frozen in the rain looking up at the ice block, camera slowly craning up to show its size

shots.image: the five friends edging cautiously toward the lodged ice block through the rain, [루카] leading, everyone tense
shots.motion: The friends creep forward step by step, rain streaming, [루카] motioning them to stay behind him

shots.image: close-up of [루카]'s paw pressing flat against the frosted ice surface, water running over his fur, curiosity and courage
shots.motion: The tiger's paw presses against the ice, frost clearing under his warmth, revealing a glow beneath

shots.image: extreme close-up through frosted translucent ice revealing the curved shell of a large pale egg glowing faintly from within, mysterious and beautiful
shots.motion: The camera drifts through the frost as it clears, the egg's shape resolving, its glow pulsing slowly

shots.image: [소미] pressed against the ice with both paws and her cheek, eyes enormous with wonder, rain dripping from her ears
shots.motion: The rabbit presses her face to the ice, her breath fogging it, eyes going wide with amazement

shots.image: extreme close-up of the egg inside the ice, its surface trembling almost imperceptibly, a heartbeat glow answering from within
shots.motion: The egg's surface shivers once, then again, the inner light pulsing in the same rhythm like a heartbeat

shots.image: the five friends crowding around the ice block, faces lit from below by the egg's soft glow against the storm-dark rain
shots.motion: The friends press in around the ice, their faces lit by the pulsing glow, rain still falling around them

shots.dialogue: 두리: 저 멀리 얼음의 땅에서 떠내려온 것 같아.
shots.image: [두리] studying the ice block closely, wiping his rain-streaked glasses, thoughtful and certain, the glowing egg behind him
shots.motion: The koala wipes his glasses, leans in to study the ice, then looks up at the others with a serious expression

shots.image: a brief imagined vision of a vast pale frozen land under a shimmering aurora, endless ice cliffs meeting a dark sea, cold and awe-inspiring, storybook memory tone
shots.motion: Slow drift across the frozen wasteland, aurora rippling overhead, wind blowing snow across the ice

shots.dialogue: 두리: 이대로 두면 계속 얼어 있을 거야.
shots.image: close-up of [두리] turning to the others, rain on his glasses, quiet worry in his eyes
shots.motion: The koala turns to face the others, his expression turning grave, rain dripping from his chin

shots.image: the five friends exchanging silent looks in the rain, a decision passing between them without words, glowing egg behind
shots.motion: The friends look at each other one by one around the circle, each nodding, resolve building

shots.image: close-up of [루카] with rain running down his face, jaw set with determination, pushing his goggles up, brave and warm
shots.motion: The tiger cub pushes his goggles up, sets his jaw, and steps forward with fierce determination

shots.dialogue: 루카: 다 같이 따뜻하게 해주는 거야!
shots.image: the five friends moving in together and pressing themselves against the huge ice block from all sides, small bodies against cold blue mass, rain pouring
shots.motion: The friends step in together and press against the ice from every side, wrapping their arms around it

shots.image: night falling over the riverbank, the storm still blowing, the ice block a pale shape in the dark with five small figures clinging to it, moonlight through torn clouds
shots.motion: Time-lapse of dusk falling into night, clouds racing, the ice glowing faintly in the darkness

shots.image: close-up of [루카] with his cheek pressed against the ice, eyes squeezed shut, fur soaked and flattened, willing his warmth into it
shots.motion: The tiger presses his cheek harder against the ice, breath fogging, water running down his face

shots.image: close-up of small paws and flippers pressed flat against the frosted ice, tiny circles of meltwater forming under each one
shots.motion: Meltwater beads and trickles down from under each paw, the frost retreating in small warm circles

shots.image: [소미] shivering violently against the ice but refusing to let go, teeth chattering, eyes shut tight with effort
shots.motion: The rabbit shivers hard, her ears trembling, but she presses in tighter instead of pulling away

shots.image: [초코] curled against the base of the ice block with [몽이] tucked under his chin, sharing warmth, rain easing off
shots.motion: The puppy curls tighter around the penguin, both shivering, their breath rising in small clouds

shots.image: the storm finally breaking, clouds tearing open to reveal a bright moon over the riverbank, the ice block half-melted with five sleeping figures around it
shots.motion: The clouds part and moonlight floods the scene, rain fading to a drizzle then stopping, everything going still

shots.image: close-up of meltwater dripping steadily from the shrinking ice block into a puddle, each drop catching the moonlight
shots.motion: Water drips steadily from the ice, each drop falling and rippling the moonlit puddle below

shots.image: the five friends asleep in a tight huddle against the much smaller ice block, exhausted, moonlight and drifting mist, tender night scene
shots.motion: The sleeping friends breathe slowly in unison, mist drifting past, moonlight shifting across them

shots.image: close-up of the egg now nearly free of ice, sitting silent and still in the moonlight, its glow gone dim and faint
shots.motion: The egg sits utterly still, its inner light so faint it seems to be fading, no movement at all

shots.image: [루카] stirring awake for a moment, lifting his head to check the egg, worry crossing his face before he settles again
shots.motion: The tiger raises his head, looks anxiously at the motionless egg, then lowers his head and closes his eyes

shots.image: the deep quiet of the night riverbank, sleeping friends and the silent egg, stars wheeling slowly overhead, a held moment of uncertainty
shots.motion: Long slow time-lapse of stars wheeling above the sleeping group, nothing else moving at all

shots.image: extreme close-up of the egg's dark surface in the last blue moments before dawn, absolutely motionless
shots.motion: The egg remains perfectly still as the light shifts from cold blue toward the first faint warmth

shots.image: the first light of dawn breaking through the torn storm clouds over the river valley, gold spilling across the wet forest, breathtaking sunrise
shots.motion: The sun's edge clears the horizon and golden light sweeps across the valley, mist igniting gold

shots.image: close-up of a shaft of sunrise light striking the remaining ice, the frost flaring brilliant gold
shots.motion: A beam of sunlight lands on the ice and travels across it, the frost blazing gold where it touches

shots.image: extreme close-up of a crack racing across the melting ice with a sharp sound, fissures spreading like lightning
shots.motion: A crack shoots across the ice surface, then another and another, branching rapidly

shots.image: the ice shell splitting apart and falling away in glittering shards, revealing the pale egg standing free in the golden dawn light
shots.motion: The ice splits and falls away in shining pieces, the egg revealed standing free and gleaming

shots.image: the five friends jolting awake at the sound, eyes flying open, scrambling upright in the dawn light
shots.motion: The friends startle awake all at once, heads snapping up, scrambling to their feet

shots.image: extreme close-up of a single crack appearing on the egg's shell with a sharp snap, then spreading
shots.motion: A crack snaps open across the eggshell, then spiders outward, pieces beginning to shift

shots.image: the five friends frozen in place staring at the cracking egg, hardly daring to breathe, dawn light on their faces
shots.motion: The friends stand utterly still, eyes wide, one of them clutching another's paw without looking

shots.image: the eggshell bursting open in a shower of fragments as a small green snout pushes through into the golden light
shots.motion: The shell bursts apart and a small snout pushes out into the sunlight, shell fragments tumbling away

shots.image: {쿵쿵} emerging from the broken shell for the first time, blinking in the sunrise, damp and wobbly and brand new
shots.motion: The baby triceratops pushes out of the shell, blinks against the light, shakes his head and looks around

shots.image: extreme close-up of {쿵쿵}'s huge green-hazel eyes opening fully for the first time, the sunrise reflected in them
shots.motion: The eyes open wide, pupils adjusting, the golden sunrise blooming in the reflection

shots.image: {쿵쿵} standing in the broken shell with his head thrown back and mouth wide open in a joyful first cry, golden sunrise backlight rimming him in light, five friends watching in awe
shots.motion: The baby triceratops throws his head back and cries out to the sky, birds scattering, golden light flaring

shots.image: {쿵쿵} trying to stand and immediately collapsing sideways into the shell fragments, legs splayed
shots.motion: The baby wobbles upright then his legs slide out from under him and he flops down with a puff of shell dust

shots.image: {쿵쿵} pushing himself up again with enormous effort, trembling on three legs before toppling over the other way
shots.motion: He pushes up shaking, holds for a second, then tips over sideways again

shots.image: close-up of the friends watching breathlessly, [소미] with both paws over her mouth, [루카] leaning forward
shots.motion: The friends lean in together, [소미] covering her mouth, nobody daring to speak

shots.image: {쿵쿵} planting both front paws firmly on the wet ground and pushing himself upright with fierce determination, third attempt
shots.motion: He plants both front paws, strains upward, legs shaking violently, and slowly rises

shots.image: {쿵쿵} standing at last, his front foot coming down solidly on the earth and sending a ring of dust and water rippling outward, morning light blazing behind him
shots.motion: His foot lands with weight, a ring of dust and water ripples outward across the ground, leaves shivering on nearby branches

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} beaming with enormous pride, chest puffed out, still wobbling slightly, dawn light on his face
shots.motion: The baby beams and puffs out his chest proudly, wobbling a little, tail wagging

shots.image: the five friends erupting in cheers around {쿵쿵}, leaping and hugging each other in the golden sunrise, pure joy after a long night
shots.motion: The friends erupt cheering, leaping into the air and grabbing each other, [초코] spinning in circles

shots.image: the riverbank in bright clear morning light after the storm, everything washed and glittering, the broken shell and the group gathered around
shots.motion: Camera drifts slowly across the sunlit riverbank, steam rising from wet stones, water sparkling

shots.image: {쿵쿵} craning his neck around to inspect his own body, twisting to look at his tail with enormous curiosity
shots.motion: The baby twists around trying to see his own tail, turning in a small circle chasing it

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} going cross-eyed trying to look at the horn on his own snout, comically focused
shots.motion: His eyes cross as he strains to see his own snout horn, then he gives up and shakes his head

shots.image: the five friends gathering in a ring around {쿵쿵}, leaning in with fascination, morning sun behind them
shots.motion: The friends close in around him in a circle, heads tilting curiously, all leaning in together

shots.image: close-up of [루카] pushing his goggles down over his eyes to inspect the newborn, delighted grin
shots.motion: The tiger cub slides his goggles down over his eyes and leans in close, grinning hugely

shots.image: [루카] tilting his head at {쿵쿵} with a friendly questioning expression, morning light between them, warm two-shot
shots.motion: The tiger tilts his head questioningly, ears forward, waiting for an answer

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} looking utterly lost, eyes searching, mouth opening and closing without an answer
shots.motion: The baby's mouth opens and closes, eyes darting side to side, his expression falling into confusion

shots.image: {쿵쿵} taking a wobbly step forward to hide his confusion, legs splaying, about to fall
shots.motion: He takes an unsteady step forward, legs sliding apart, arms windmilling for balance

shots.image: {쿵쿵} tipping over and landing flat on his belly with a heavy thump, dust puffing outward in a ring
shots.motion: He tips forward and lands flat with a heavy thump, a ring of dust puffing out around him

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵}'s foot coming down heavily on the earth, small stones and water droplets jumping at the impact
shots.motion: The foot lands and the ground shudders, pebbles and droplets bouncing up from the impact

shots.image: {쿵쿵} getting up and taking three more heavy determined steps, each landing with a solid thump, dust rings blooming
shots.motion: He rises and stomps forward three times, each step landing heavily and puffing dust outward

shots.image: [루카] doubled over laughing with delight at the thumping sound, holding his sides, the other friends starting to laugh too
shots.motion: The tiger cub doubles over laughing, slapping the ground, the others catching the laughter one by one

shots.dialogue: 루카: 이름이 없으면 내가 지어줄게. 너 발소리가 딱 '쿵쿵'이잖아!
shots.image: [루카] straightening up with a bright idea lighting his face, one paw raised, pointing at {쿵쿵} warmly
shots.motion: The tiger straightens up with a sudden bright idea, raising one paw, eyes shining

shots.dialogue: 루카: 게다가 태어날 때도 땅이 '쿵' 울렸다고!
shots.image: [루카] gesturing at the ground where the newborn first stood, the others nodding in recognition, warm morning light
shots.motion: The tiger gestures at the ground, the others look and nod, remembering, smiles spreading

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} lighting up with the biggest joyful smile of his life, hearing his own name for the first time
shots.motion: The baby's whole face lights up, he beams and bounces on his front paws with excitement

shots.image: the group cheering and clapping around {쿵쿵} in the bright morning sun, celebration of a name, warm wide shot
shots.motion: The friends cheer and clap around him, [초코] running circles, everyone laughing in the sunlight

shots.image: the sunny forest clearing again, now with six friends walking in together, {쿵쿵} in the middle wobbling slightly, morning light
shots.motion: The group walks into the clearing together, the newborn wobbling in the middle, everyone matching his slow pace

shots.image: [몽이] gazing up at {쿵쿵} with enormous dreamy eyes, flippers clasped together in wonder, sunlight behind them
shots.motion: The penguin gazes up in wonder, flippers clasped, rocking slightly on his feet

shots.dialogue: 몽이: 나도 날개가 있었으면 저렇게 컸을까?
shots.image: [몽이] stretching his tiny flippers out wide and looking up at the sky wistfully, dreaming of flight
shots.motion: The penguin stretches his flippers wide and flaps hopefully, looking up at the sky, then droops a little

shots.dialogue: 소미: 너무 귀여워! 우리 같이 놀자!
shots.image: [소미] bouncing up to {쿵쿵} and taking his front paw in both of hers, sparkling with delight
shots.motion: The rabbit bounces over and grabs his paw with both of hers, shaking it happily, ears bobbing

shots.image: close-up of [두리] adjusting his glasses while studying {쿵쿵}'s three horns with scholarly seriousness
shots.motion: The koala pushes his glasses up his nose, leans in to examine the horns, and makes a thoughtful note

shots.image: [초코] snuffling energetically around {쿵쿵}'s feet, tail wagging furiously, nose twitching
shots.motion: The puppy snuffles around his feet enthusiastically, tail wagging hard, then sneezes and shakes his head

shots.image: {쿵쿵} looking around at all five new faces, overwhelmed and happy, morning sun on his face
shots.motion: The baby turns his head to look at each friend in turn, his smile growing wider with each one

shots.image: the six friends together in the sunny clearing, a group portrait moment, wildflowers and warm light, the new family complete
shots.motion: The six gather together and settle into a group, [초코] leaping into frame at the last second, everyone laughing

shots.image: the friends teaching {쿵쿵} to walk properly, [루카] demonstrating exaggerated careful steps while the baby copies him
shots.motion: The tiger demonstrates a slow careful step, the baby copies it clumsily and nearly topples, both laugh

shots.image: {쿵쿵} managing several steady steps in a row while the friends cheer him on from both sides
shots.motion: He walks several steps steadily as the friends cheer from either side, wobbling but staying up

shots.image: the six friends heading off together toward a stream visible through the trees, midday sun high and bright
shots.motion: The group walks off together toward the stream, camera following behind them through dappled light

shots.image: a clear stream running bright over rounded stones in the midday sun, deceptively strong current in the middle channel, inviting and beautiful
shots.motion: Camera glides low over the sparkling stream, sunlight fracturing on the water, current running fast in the center

shots.image: the six friends splashing and playing in the shallows at the stream edge, water flying, pure summer joy
shots.motion: The friends splash each other in the shallows, water droplets flying and catching the light

shots.image: [소미] hopping from stone to stone out toward the middle of the stream, delighted with her own daring
shots.motion: The rabbit hops stone to stone getting further out, laughing, growing bolder with each jump

shots.image: close-up of [소미]'s foot slipping on a wet mossy stone, her balance breaking
shots.motion: Her foot slides off the slick moss, her arms fly out, and she pitches sideways toward the water

shots.image: [소미] falling into the fast current and being swept away downstream, arms flailing, panic on her face
shots.motion: The rabbit hits the water and is instantly swept downstream, head bobbing, arms thrashing

shots.image: the friends on the bank frozen in shock for a heartbeat, then breaking into panic, [루카] shouting
shots.motion: The friends freeze for one beat then explode into motion, shouting and running along the bank

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵}'s face changing from confusion to fierce resolve in an instant, eyes locking on the stream
shots.motion: The baby's confused expression hardens into determination, his eyes narrowing on the water

shots.image: {쿵쿵} charging past the others and leaping off the bank into the stream without hesitation, huge splash
shots.motion: The baby charges past the others and launches off the bank into the water, a huge splash erupting

shots.image: {쿵쿵} floundering badly in the current, head barely above water, paddling clumsily but pushing forward
shots.motion: He flounders and goes under briefly, resurfaces spluttering, and paddles determinedly onward

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵}'s face half underwater, eyes fixed ahead with absolute stubbornness, water streaming over him
shots.motion: Water washes over his face but his eyes stay locked forward, jaw set, refusing to stop

shots.image: a fallen branch floating in the current between {쿵쿵} and [소미], the obvious lifeline
shots.motion: The branch turns slowly in the current, sunlight flashing off the wet bark, drifting between them

shots.image: {쿵쿵} hooking the floating branch with his snout horn and shoving it hard toward [소미], straining with everything he has
shots.motion: He catches the branch on his horn and drives it forward through the water toward the rabbit, straining hard

shots.image: close-up of [소미]'s paws catching the branch and gripping it tight, relief flooding her face
shots.motion: Her paws slap onto the branch and clamp tight, her head coming up out of the water, gasping

shots.image: [소미] clinging to the branch while {쿵쿵} pushes from behind, both bobbing in the current
shots.motion: The rabbit clings to the branch as the baby shoves from behind, both of them turning slowly in the current

shots.image: [루카] and [초코] wading out from the bank into the shallows, reaching for the branch, teamwork
shots.motion: The tiger and puppy wade in fast, arms outstretched, grabbing for the branch as it comes near

shots.image: the group hauling [소미] and {쿵쿵} up onto the pebbled bank, everyone soaked and gasping
shots.motion: They haul both of them up onto the stones, everyone collapsing down, water streaming off their fur

shots.image: the six friends sitting soaked on the sunny bank catching their breath, water dripping everywhere, relief settling in
shots.motion: The friends sit dripping in the sun, chests heaving, slowly beginning to laugh with relief

shots.image: close-up of [초코] shaking himself violently and spraying everyone with water, comic relief
shots.motion: The puppy shakes himself hard, spraying water over everyone, the others recoiling and laughing

shots.image: [소미] taking {쿵쿵}'s paw with both of hers, soaked and grateful, looking straight into his eyes
shots.motion: The rabbit takes his paw in both of hers, still dripping, and looks up at him with shining eyes

shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} ducking his head bashfully, cheeks flushed pink, embarrassed little smile
shots.motion: The baby ducks his head shyly, scuffing one foot, cheeks going pink, smiling awkwardly

shots.dialogue: 루카: 무서운데도 뛰어드는 게 진짜 용기지.
shots.image: [루카] crouching down to {쿵쿵}'s eye level with a warm proud grin, one paw on his shoulder
shots.motion: The tiger crouches to eye level and puts a paw on the baby's shoulder, grinning warmly

shots.dialogue: 루카: 태어날 때 폭풍 속에서도 씩씩하게 나왔잖아!
shots.image: [루카] gesturing back toward the river valley where the storm had been, the others nodding in agreement
shots.motion: The tiger gestures back toward the valley, the others nodding, and the baby's face slowly lights up

shots.image: the six friends in a wet happy tangle on the sunny stream bank, afternoon light warming them dry
shots.motion: The friends pile together laughing in the sun, steam rising faintly from their drying fur

shots.image: a grassy hilltop above the forest at sunset, the whole valley spread out below in orange light, six small figures walking up the slope
shots.motion: The six climb the hill in silhouette against the sunset, grass rippling, camera craning up with them

shots.image: the six friends settling down in a row on the hilltop grass, shoulder to shoulder, facing the sunset
shots.motion: They settle down one by one in a row, shuffling closer together, all facing the same direction

shots.image: {쿵쿵} sitting among the friends looking out at the orange sunset, thoughtful and content, warm rim light on his face
shots.motion: The baby gazes at the sunset, blinking slowly, the warm light glowing along his outline

shots.dialogue: 쿵쿵: 벌써 친구가 다섯 명이나 생겼어!
shots.image: {쿵쿵} turning to look down the row at all five friends with an enormous happy smile, sunset behind them
shots.motion: He turns to look down the row at each friend, his smile spreading, the others turning to look back

shots.dialogue: 전원: 우리 앞으로도 계속 같이 놀자!
shots.image: the six friends throwing their arms up together in a joyful cheer on the hilltop against the blazing sunset, silhouette composition
shots.motion: All six throw their arms up cheering together, silhouetted against the sunset, birds scattering above

shots.image: {쿵쿵} standing up and planting both front paws on his hips in his signature confident pose, chest out, sunset blazing behind him
shots.motion: He stands, plants his paws on his hips proudly, and his foot stamps down sending a ring of dust into the golden light

shots.image: wide silhouette of the six friends on the hilltop against a deep orange and violet sunset sky, the valley dark below, heartwarming finale
shots.motion: Camera pulls back and rises, the six silhouetted small against the enormous sunset sky, wind moving the grass

shots.image: the sunset sky deepening to violet with the first stars appearing over the darkened forest valley, peaceful close of day
shots.motion: The sky deepens as stars emerge one by one, the last light draining from the horizon

shots.image: an end card illustration of {쿵쿵} in his signature pose on a hilltop with the five friends behind him, warm sunset palette, empty space at the bottom for text
shots.motion: Gentle push in on the end card illustration, light sparkles drifting, everything settling into stillness
